subject: general
question: His compositions for blockbusters such as Silsila and Chandni are a manifestation of his musical brilliance. Who is he?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Pandit Shivkumar Sharma**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/7a63139f3b57ffe3814d27f8dcaee8cb420142f7146b480d479d526074519671.png] **__In News__**

__
 
• Renowned santoor player Pandit Shivkumar Sharma passed away in May 2022.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **Key Points__**

__
 
• A Padma Vibhushan recipient, Pt Shivkumar Sharma was born in Jammu in 1938 and is believed to be the first musician to have played Indian classical music on the santoor.
 
• He composed music with flute legend Pt Hari Prasad Chaurasia for an array of films such as** "Silsila", "Lamhe", "Chandni" and "Darr".**
 
• Sharma was awarded the Sangeet Natak Akademi Award in 1986 and the Padma Shri and Padma Bhushan in 1991 and 2001.

** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] Additional Information__**

 
• Ustad Bismillah Khan was an Indian maestro shehnai devoted.

 
 
• On March 21, 1916, the much-celebrated musician was born into the musicians' family.
 
• He was born in Bihar.
 
• Ustad Bismillah has received prestigious awards, such as Padma Bhushan, Padma Shri, Bharat Ratna, and Padma Vibhushan, and has become a worldwide famous name.
 
• He perfected the art of playing the shehnai and also had the distinction of playing in 1947 on the eve of the Indian independence.
 
 
 
• Ustad Zakir Hussain:
 
 
• Ustad Zakir Hussain, son of tabla player Ustad Allah Rakha, is the most famous classical tabla player in India today.
 
• He is appreciated both in the field of percussion and in the music world at large.
 
• He was awarded Padma Shri in the year 1988 and Padma Bhushan in 2002.
 
• The list of his awards also includes the Sangeet Natak Akademi Award, given by India's National academy of Music, Dance, and Drama which he received in 1990.
 
 
 
• Jagjit Singh:
 
 
• Jagjit Singh was an Indian composer, singer, and musician. 
 
• He composed and sang in numerous languages and is credited for the revival and popularity of ghazal.
 
• Jagjit Singh was born Jagmohan Singh in Rajasthan's Sri Ganganagar.
 
• The Rajasthan government was awarded the Rajasthan Ratna award posthumously in 2012.
 
• **In 2003, the government of India awarded Padma Bhushan to him.**
